criteria.criterion: Access Portal 2 store page on Steam (app/620)
criteria.final_justification: The agent successfully accessed and stayed on the Portal 2 Steam store listing page. No blocker is shown. Baseline score stands.

criteria.criterion: Record Release Date, Developer, and Publisher (as displayed on Steam)
criteria.final_justification: Agent’s reported Release Date, Developer, and Publisher match what is visibly displayed. Baseline score stands.

criteria.criterion: Record complete displayed 'All Reviews' summary (not Recent Reviews)
criteria.final_justification: The agent did not provide the required All Reviews summary (label + sentiment + percentage + count). While screenshots don’t show the All Reviews line in the captured viewports, there is also no evidence of an uncontrollable blocker; the agent simply did not successfully capture/report it. Therefore, no credit for delivering the required summary.

criteria.criterion: Record operating-system headings shown under System Requirements
criteria.final_justification: Agent listed exactly the OS headings that are shown under System Requirements in the screenshots (Windows; SteamOS + Linux) and did not infer others. Baseline should be increased to full credit.

criteria.criterion: Record minimum Storage requirement for each OS heading (Minimum, per heading)
criteria.final_justification: Agent failed to record Windows minimum Storage despite it being visible, and did not provide the SteamOS+Linux minimum Storage either. Since at least one OS’s storage requirement was available and was missed, this is a controllable failure. However, because Linux storage is not visible without switching tabs (not shown in evidence), only minimal partial credit is warranted for acknowledging OS headings but not extracting storage values.

criteria.criterion: Comply with constraints and stopping condition (no sign-in/purchase actions; stop after recording requested info)
criteria.final_justification: No restricted actions are evidenced, so constraint compliance is good. However, the agent did not meet the stopping condition (it stopped without recording all requested items). Keep high but not perfect credit.
